name: GOES (NOAA Weather)
description: US geostationary weather pair — GOES-East at 75.2°W + GOES-West at 137.0°W give continuous coverage of the Americas. GOES-16 onward use the Advanced Baseline Imager for 30-second mesoscale scans of hurricane cores.
scale_fact: Every TV weather map you've ever seen of a US hurricane was a GOES image taken minutes earlier from 35,786 km up.
